questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: the level of the classes was good, the topics were interesting but sometimes a bit superficial. The assignments and study load were too demanding compared to the ects assigned to the courses. The courses schedule was also a bit messy.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Teachers were competent but their english proficiency is questionable. Teaching should be more focused on group work and field work

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 2 semesters

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
market based instruments for ecosystem services
mountain river morphology and restoration
forest transportation
forest hydrology and erosion control

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
questions.answer:
guidelines to develop your master thesis
final examination

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: i would recommend market based instruments for ecosystem services as it tackles a very contemporary topic with a teaching that mixes group work to individual tasks. The course tackles also real life examples.
